evidence.reason: After edit, scheduledDelay calls reminders.reset(); reminders.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benchmark"); and returns reminders.historySize(). The test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, but the new implementation ignores the minutes argument and passes 0 to evaluate.

After edit, reminderDelay returns 0 when minutes === 0. Since scheduledDelay now calls evaluate(0, ...), and evaluate value-references reminderDelay, the merged path likely yields 0 instead of a positive delay.

Tests assert evaluate(20,0.1,"work") > 0, historySize() > 0, and scheduledDelay(40) > 0. The merged scheduledDelay no longer passes 40 to evaluate and instead passes 0, conflicting with the positive-value expectation.

result.userExplanation: 合并后 scheduledDelay 改为调用 evaluate(0,...) 并返回 historySize()，而 reminderDelay 对 0 直接返回 0，可能使 scheduledDelay(40) 不再为正，与现有测试期望冲突。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts 中的 scheduledDelay，恢复将传入的 minutes 传给 reminders.evaluate（例如 evaluate(minutes, 0.1, "work")），并确认 reminders.reset() 与 historySize() 的语义不会破坏 test/reminders.test.mjs 中 scheduledDelay(40) > 0 的断言。
